result.instructions: Tools for Solo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my last 20 invoices and show which ones are not paid yet."; "Show the line items and VAT of invoice 12-1-1."; "Which of my offers are still open?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Solo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run solo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run solo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run solo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. solo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: solo_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the last 1000 invoices (račun) of the Solo account: id, number, date, gross total, status and status colour. Use solo_get_invoice with an id for full details. Solo API: GET /racun.

page.description: Page number (only needed when there are more than 1000 documents).

tools.name: solo_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with buyer, line items, taxes, totals, payment method, dates, IBAN, currency and a PDF link. The id is the long hash from solo_list_invoices. Solo API: GET /racun?id=.

tools.name: solo_get_invoice_status
tools.title: Get invoice status
tools.description: Get the payment status of one invoice: status code, colour and the payment date (datum_uplate, empty if unpaid). Solo API: GET /status?id=.

tools.name: solo_list_offers
tools.title: List offers
tools.description: List the last 1000 offers (ponuda) of the Solo account: id, number, date, gross total, status. Use solo_get_offer for full details. Solo API: GET /ponuda.

page.description: Page number (only needed when there are more than 1000 documents).

tools.name: solo_get_offer
tools.title: Get offer
tools.description: Get one offer with buyer, line items, taxes, totals, dates, currency and a PDF link. The id is the long hash from solo_list_offers. Solo API: GET /ponuda?id=.

tools.name: solo_get_offer_status
tools.title: Get offer status
tools.description: Get the status code and colour of one offer. Solo API: GET /status?id=.

tools.name: solo_list_catalog
tools.title: List catalog
tools.description: List the products and services in the Solo catalog: code (sifra), KPD code, description, unit, quantity, price, discount and tax rate. Solo API: GET /katalog.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Solo
prompts.description: What you can do with Solo here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_the_invoices_that_are_not_paid_yet
prompts.title: Find the invoices that are not paid yet
prompts.description: List the latest invoices of the account. Check the payment status of each one and see which ones have no payment date.

prompts.name: check_the_line_items_and_vat_of_an_invoice
prompts.title: Check the line items and VAT of an invoice
prompts.description: Open one invoice to read the buyer, the line items, the taxes, the totals and the PDF link. Use it to answer a question from a client.

prompts.name: follow_up_on_open_offers
prompts.title: Follow up on open offers
prompts.description: List the offers of the account and read the status of each one. Open an offer to see the buyer, the items and the total before you call the client.

prompts.name: review_the_products_and_prices_in_the_catalog
prompts.title: Review the products and prices in the catalog
prompts.description: List the products and services with the code, unit, price, discount and tax rate. Use the list to check the prices before you write a new offer.
